name: Zando'zan

meta.previous: To Orgrimmar! or Find the Shattered Hand

summary: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, promising rogues begin training with the Shattered Hand. Trainer Shenthul sends his chosen initiate to meet Zando'zan and enter the Horde's covert ranks.

sections.title: A Walk into the Shadows
sections.body: Orgrimmar's rulers know brute strength cannot win every war. Beneath the city, the Cleft of Shadow houses the Shattered Hand, a covert guild that handles espionage, sabotage, and theft for the Horde. When rogue trainer Shenthul sees promise in an initiate, he sends them to report to Zando'zan for dedicated operative training.

sections.title: Proving One's Worth
sections.body: Zando'zan does not grant respect to every inexperienced rogue who enters the cavern. Meeting him marks a formal initiation into the finer clandestine arts, beginning with stealth, subterfuge, and thievery. His training bridges the distance between rough street cutpurses and organized intelligence operatives, preparing rogues for fieldwork beyond the safety of the capital's red canyon walls.

faq.answer: Zando'zan is a rogue trainer and Shattered Hand handler in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He evaluates new recruits and teaches practical stealth, burglary, and operative tradecraft.

faq.q: Why does Shenthul send rogues to see Zando'zan?
aliases: why do i talk to zando'zan
faq.answer: Shenthul sends promising rogues to Zando'zan when they need specialized training as Shattered Hand operatives. Zando'zan oversees lessons in burglary and lock manipulation for clandestine fieldwork.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand began as a brutal orcish clan from Draenor, known for ritual self-mutilation, and evolved into the Horde's covert intelligence and assassination arm. Operating from Orgrimmar's shadows, its members handle espionage, poison, and scouting.

faq.q: Where does this training chain lead next?
faq.answer: After you present yourself to Zando'zan, he sends you to Ratchet on the Barrens coast to consult Wrenix, a goblin contact, and begin practical lockpicking fieldwork.
Zando'zan works in the Cleft of Shadow, a deep cavern network beneath Orgrimmar's center. Warlocks, shadow priests, and rogue operatives gather there out of broad daylight.

faq.q: Why does Zando'zan apologize upon meeting me?
faq.answer: Zando'zan may have doubted your nerve before you arrived. Seeing you ready to train, he acknowledges your commitment and takes back his initial skepticism.

angles.text: As a rogue, you enter the Shattered Hand's covert ranks, moving from an untrained knifefighter to a recognized Horde operative.
The Shattered Hand handles the Horde's espionage and covert work, guarding it against threats hidden from view even as the warchief speaks of honor and frontal assault.
